title: Translation with back-translation verification
description: Translates content, independently back-translates it, compares semantic fidelity, and resolves material drift.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: translation-backtranslation-verification
  title: Translation with back-translation verification
  description: Translates content, independently back-translates it, compares semantic fidelity, and resolves material drift.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Deliver culturally appropriate translations with verified meaning preservation.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - linguist-signoff
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source text and language requirements
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
          - sourceLanguage
          - targetLanguage
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: translate
      kind: agent
      name: Translate source text
      role: Professional translator
      prompt: Translate faithfully for the specified audience. Preserve terminology, numbers, tone, and formatting.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: backtranslate
      kind: agent
      name: Blind back-translation
      role: Independent translator
      prompt: Translate the target text back into the source language without viewing the original.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: compare
      kind: agent
      name: Verify semantic fidelity
      role: Translation reviewer
      prompt: Compare original and back-translation. Flag material meaning, tone, terminology, numeric, or cultural deviations.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: revise
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded translation revision
      config:
        body:
          - translate
          - backtranslate
          - compare
        exitCondition: compare.materialDeviations == 0
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: linguist-signoff
      kind: approval
      name: Lead linguist signs off
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Verified translation and review log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: translate
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: translate
      to: backtranslate
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: backtranslate
      to: compare
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: compare
      to: revise
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e5
      from: compare
      to: linguist-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e6
      from: revise
      to: linguist-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e7
      from: linguist-signoff
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: revise-exit
      from: revise
      to: linguist-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
